digest.component_or_area: code-review gate dispatch and project criteria routing
propositions: Project-supplied code-review criteria with applies_to field are stored and validated but never consulted during dispatch, causing them to run unconditionally on every review regardless of changed files.
The dispatch path (_activated_code_review_project_criteria) filters only on criterion_id prefix and exec type, ignoring applies_to and taking no changed-files argument.
Project criteria bypass the workflow membership gating by appending after req.criteria, circumventing the gate YAML's when: expressions that would normally filter based on applies_to.

applies_to lacks shape validation at overlay load time (non-list, non-string elements, or bare strings are silently accepted), allowing malformed entries to silently narrow to empty list and revert to always-on behavior.
Plan-review criteria ARE gated on applies_at and file_impact_globs, creating asymmetry; code-review has no equivalent gating logic.

Empty or absent applies_to should leave project criteria always-on (ungated), while non-empty applies_to should gate dispatch to matching changed files using glob matching against effective_routing(repo_root).
